name: 涉税（评估/异议/复议）流程

map.🧾 涉税（评估/异议/复议）流程: 🧾 Tax Assessment, Objection and Review Procedure
map.涉税评估流程指引工具，展示涉税评估、异议申请和行政复议的完整流程，输入评估价值计: A procedural guide to tax-related assessment, objection and administrative review; enter the assessed value to compute the disputed amount and review cost.
map.📖 查看「涉税（评估/异议/复议）流程 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Tax Assessment, Objection and Review Procedure User Guide"
map.涉税异议应在收到通知后10日内提出书面申请: A tax objection must be filed in writing within 10 days of receiving the notice
map.行政复议应在收到异议答复后60日内申请: Administrative review must be applied for within 60 days of receiving the objection reply
map.对复议决定不服可在15日内提起行政诉讼: Dissatisfaction with the review decision allows administrative litigation within 15 days
map.提供市场交易证据有助于异议成功: Supplying market transaction evidence improves the odds of a successful objection
map.📚 深度解析：涉税评估异议与复议: 📚 In-depth: Tax Assessment Objections and Review
map.认为计税评估值偏高时计算多缴税款并发起异议。: Compute the overpaid tax and raise an objection when the assessed value looks too high.
map.对税务机关核定提出书面异议的时限管理。: Manage the deadline for written objections to a tax authority's assessment.
map.异议不被采纳时准备行政复议材料。: Prepare administrative review materials when an objection is rejected.
map.评估值 500 万、市场实际价值 450 万 → 差额 50 万；适用契税税率: Assessed value of 5 million yuan against an actual market value of 4.5 million gives a 500,000 gap; at a 2% deed tax rate the overpaid tax = 50 × 2% = 10,000 yuan, which supports the objection.
map.收到评估通知后 10 日内提书面异议，异议不被采纳后 60 日内向上一级税务机关: File a written objection within 10 days of the assessment notice; if rejected, apply for administrative review with the next higher tax authority within 60 days; if still dissatisfied, administrative litigation may be brought within 15 days.
map.异议要准备什么证据？: What evidence is needed for an objection?
map.近期真实成交合同、评估报告、周边挂牌价截图等能证明市场价值的材料，越具体越易被采: Recent genuine sale contracts, appraisal reports, screenshots of nearby listing prices and any other material evidencing market value; the more specific, the more likely it is accepted.
map.评估值低于市场价有风险吗？: Is there risk if the assessed value is below market?
map.有，税务机关可能按核定价上调计税依据，反而多缴，应如实申报并留存证据。: Yes. The tax authority may raise the tax base to its assessed price and you could end up paying more; declare accurately and keep the evidence.

map.涉税评估流程指引工具展示涉税评估、异议申请、行政复议和行政诉讼的完整流程，计算评: The guide lays out the full path of tax assessment, objection, administrative review and litigation, and computes the assessment gap and overpaid tax so taxpayers know their remedies.
